part: xc7z020clg400-1 (target; this run is RTL sim, not on board)
cache_policy: icache/dcache enabled (cold lines warmed by a first call before measurement)
measurement_scope: crypto_aead_encrypt / crypto_aead_decrypt call only (mcycle delta; excludes UART)
repetitions: 1 warm-up call + 1 measured call (warm-cycle, min not taken)
kat_on_target: 6 official vectors (empty/1B/16B/16B+AD/17B/32B) encrypt+decrypt PASS; 1 tamper-reject PASS. Full 1089 KAT on target not run (host only).
notes: Cycle/instruction counts are warm (steady-state) measurements from RTL simulation of soc_top, not board measurements. mcycle read via CSR 0xB00/0xB80 (high-low-high); instructions via cpi_cnt MMIO 0x60000000/04. Measurement includes a few cycles/instructions of counter-read overhead (<1%). UART at 115200 dominates wall-cycle count but is excluded from the measured region.
